title: Folhas de Operação — Análise
prompt:
Create one high-fidelity desktop screenshot mockup for the existing GO Itaim Dashboard Geral, route Análise, landscape 1600x1000. No browser chrome or device frame. Use the chosen "Folhas de Operação" design system, matching the supplied approved Visão Geral reference: warm ivory paper canvas, graphite typography, cobalt navigation and primary selection, narrow yellow divider tabs, restrained acetate-like panels and thin ruled lines. Practical dense dashboard, clean contrast, no gradients or decorative noise. Use the official GO Itaim logo reference; preserve product name and current Portuguese terms.

Show the persistent app shell: a compact left sidebar with exact groups and items: Principal (Visão Geral, Análise selected, UTR, Comparação), Operacional (Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado), Marketing (Operacional Marketing, Marketing). Header has breadcrumb "Principal › Análise" on left, center ticker with green refresh icon and "Sincronizado" plus a horizontally clipped, visibly scrolling sequence "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09", subtle fade edges; theme/profile on right. The city/date pairs are demonstrative placeholders.

Immediately under the header, show the complete actual dashboard filter in two visible rows: Period mode "Ano/Semana" selected and "Intervalo", "Ano 2026", multi-select "Semana 05, 06, 07"; second row individual selects "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", and "Limpar". Keep every control legible, no summary chips.

Main content: heading "Análise detalhada". Show five restrained metric cards: "Horas Entregues", "Ofertadas", "Aceitas" with "TAXA DE ACEITAÇÃO", "Rejeitadas" with "TAXA DE REJEIÇÃO", "Completadas" with "TAXA DE COMPLETUDE". Beneath, a large data panel with tabs "Dia" selected, "Turno", "Sub Praça", "Origem", and a table/heatmap with real dimensions: Dia, Ofertadas, Aceitas, Rejeitadas, Completadas, Aderência; include a compact daily series chart only if space remains. Values are sample placeholders, not database data. Keep critical table text readable and the global filter fully above content. No unconfirmed features or invented alerts.
demoData: Indicadores demonstrativos; não usar como dados do Supabase.
